result.reason: The skill extracts direct-message recipient identifiers from stored sessions and uses them to send notifications. It also reads user OAuth credentials from Keychain and persists them in Clawdbot’s auth profiles.

evidence.quote:
# Find first direct (non-group) session with delivery context
    local session_data=$(jq -r '
        to_entries[] | 
        select(.value.chatType == "direct") |
        select(.value.deliveryContext != null) |
        {
            channel: .value.deliveryContext.channel,
            to: (.value.deliveryContext.to // .value.lastTo)
        } | 
        @json
    ' "$SESSIONS_FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -1)

if command -v clawdbot &> /dev/null; then
        clawdbot message send --target "$NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$message" >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 || true
    fi

1. Reads OAuth tokens from macOS Keychain (where Claude CLI stores them)
2. Writes them to `~/.clawdbot/agents/main/agent/auth-profiles.json` in **proper OAuth format**:
